sav_input.mission: The security team and the product engineering team need to reach an agreement on access controls and deployment pract…
sav_input.final_decision:
{
  "access controls": "SSO + MFA for all human access; break-glass accounts with approval and periodic review",
  "adequately protect": "Define protection as meeting specific frameworks/controls (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) and internal risk thresholds",
  "allow developers to move quickly": "Set explicit developer experience targets: max approval latency (e.g., <4h) and CI pipeline time (e.g., <15 min)",
  "auditors the visibility they require": "Evidence-as-code: automated control reports generated from CI/CD, IaC, and identity systems vs manual evidence collection each audit",
  "can realistically be adopted and maintained": "Leverage shared core services (Identity, Governance, Observability) with standard integrations vs bespoke per-team tooling",
  "customer data": "Define as PII only vs include telemetry/log data, support tickets, and behavioral analytics",
  "deployment practices": "Mandatory CI/CD checks: SAST/DAST, dependency scan, IaC scan, unit/integration tests as gated steps vs advisory (non-blocking) for low-risk repos",
  "reach an agreement": "Single joint policy package ratified by Security+Engineering leads with explicit acceptance criteria and sign-off date",
  "sensitive systems": "Scope only production systems handling secrets/PII/payment data vs include all internal tooling with privileged access",
  "the teams that have to live with them every day": "RACI agreement: which team owns policy, tooling, exceptions, and incident response vs shared ownership with rotating duty",
  "without unnecessary friction": "Risk-based gating: only high-risk changes require human approval; low-risk fully automated"
}
